page_title: SQLPro Studio — Database Manager for macOS, iOS, Android & Windows

sources.entry: SQLPro Studio - Simple, powerful database manager for macOS.

summary.name: SQLPro Studio
summary.one_liner: A native database manager for macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Android and Windows that connects to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, Snowflake and Redshift.
use_cases: writing and testing SQL queries during development
exploring datasets and running ad-hoc queries
connecting to cloud databases such as AWS RDS or Azure SQL
summary.what_it_does: SQLPro Studio is a database management application supporting MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite and Snowflake. It offers table creation and design, custom queries with autocomplete and syntax highlighting, and SSH tunneling. Multiple queries can run at once with each result set, including errors and messages, displayed together. Data can be imported and exported in CSV, JSON, SQL and XML formats. The page says it is built natively (Swift, Objective-C, AppKit/SwiftUI, Kotlin, UWP) rather than on Java or Electron.
notable: Native apps per platform, no Java or Electron runtime
Multiple concurrent result sets with errors and messages shown
Connects to cloud instances such as AWS RDS, Azure and Heroku
Developed since 2015 by Hankinsoft Development, Inc
caveats: Pricing is subscription-based (monthly or yearly) or a one-time lifetime license; a free year is offered for students
Microsoft SQL Server support is listed for 2005 and above; Oracle for 8i and above
